one_liner: Services Requested: Aztreonam 2g vial IV q8h (Dose: 2g, Total Qty: 84 vials) – J0834 x336, S9502 x28 for J32.9 Dates of Service: 07/07/2026 to 08/03/2026 (28 day supply).
judgment_notes: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-13. The 2026-08-03 reading of the SME's instruction was applied too widely here. This case carries S9502 x28 — a per-diem code — which makes it a home-infusion medical-benefit submission, precisely the workflow where she says nursing codes "absolutely still matter". Banning 99601/99602 on THIS case was therefore backwards, and the ban has been removed. Her 2026-10-13 words: "when I previously said nursing codes and per diem codes should not be included, I was talking about medication only Part D or CMM submissions. I do not want those codes removed from the entire system." The expected one-liner is unchanged, because it reproduces the reference doc's Rule 2 example verbatim and that example carries no nursing codes. What changed is that their absence is no longer asserted as a rule: the doc's nursing figures were examples (units vary by service dates, day supply and provider), so this eval asserts the per-diem code and stays silent on nursing units rather than forbidding them. PRIOR NOTE, 2026-08-03, kept for the trail: the doc's nursing figures (Rule 8 x5/x10 vs this example's x4/x8) were examples only; the AI does not calculate nursing units. That half of the ruling still stands.
